scope: frontend-only chat archive save, manual import, automatic restoration
evidence_level: source inspection and Node tests; no native browser or OS dialog operated by this agent

resolution.status: source fix implemented and regression suite passes; native verification remains with root
resolution.production_change: Removed remembered-handle reads from handleRestoreArchive. Manual restore immediately opens showOpenFilePicker or input. tryAutoRestoreOnOpen continues using the remembered handle.
resolution.new_regressions: Both native and input paths: valid A to selected B, malformed A to selected B, cancellation preserves A handle/file bytes/local backup/current messages; readable remembered handle still takes priority during automatic restoration.
resolution.warnings: Existing Node DEP0040 punycode deprecation warning is present; no failing tests.
resolution.validation_boundary: Node tests use JSDOM/mocked pickers and IndexedDB plus real temporary UTF-8 files. This agent did not operate a browser, verify actual OS dialogs/downloads, run typecheck/build/lint, or modify the HTML report.

baseline.boundary: JSDOM, mocked picker and IndexedDB; file-handle mock writes real temporary UTF-8 files

confirmed_source_failure.title: Remembered archive prevents selecting a different file during manual restore
confirmed_source_failure.trigger: Save or import archive A so its readable handle is remembered, then click Restore intending to select B
confirmed_source_failure.actual: Handle A is read first. showOpenFilePicker and input.click never run. A replaces the current conversation, or a now-malformed A reports an error without offering B.
confirmed_source_failure.red_result: 2 failures: valid remembered A and malformed remembered A both produce pickerCalls 0 instead of 1
confirmed_source_failure.suggested_minimal_fix: Manual restore always opens the native picker or input fallback; remembered handles remain available to automatic restoration.

native_checks_for_root.check: After A has been saved or imported, Restore must open a picker so B can be selected; repeat after modifying A into malformed JSON.
native_checks_for_root.why: Confirmed source failure above, awaiting native reproduction.

native_checks_for_root.check: Native save writes actual bytes, preserving Chinese, emoji, escaped quotes and line breaks; re-open selected file and compare messages/roles/times.
native_checks_for_root.why: Existing tests exercise a Node fs-backed handle, not real FileSystemWritableFileStream.

native_checks_for_root.check: Cancel the native open/save dialog and input fallback dialog; current conversation and previous backup stay intact, then another save/import/send remains usable.
native_checks_for_root.why: AbortError and DOM cancel are mocked in tests; actual native dialog event delivery is not proven.

native_checks_for_root.check: Import malformed JSON, wrong-kind JSON, empty file and schema-invalid JSON; no message replacement or remembered-handle change, then a valid file can still be imported.
native_checks_for_root.why: Current schema tests prove source guards, not rendered UX or actual File.text errors.

native_checks_for_root.check: Where no Save File Picker is available, anchor download reaches the actual download directory and downloaded bytes can be imported.
native_checks_for_root.why: The helper's URL is revoked in a later timer, and a successful click alone does not prove download completion.

native_checks_for_root.check: Reload after import, verify automatic restoration with retained file permission and with permission no longer granted; local backup should recover the imported archive.
native_checks_for_root.why: Real structured cloning of FileSystemFileHandle, browser permission persistence and reload timing are not covered by mock IDB.

native_checks_for_root.check: If the initial IndexedDB read is slow, verify explicit Restore still opens a picker after a real click.
native_checks_for_root.why: Before the proposed fix, manual restore awaits IDB and file read before opening the picker; mock tests cannot establish actual transient user activation behavior.

native_checks_for_root.check: Observe button disabled state while a slow picker/file operation stays open for more than 300 ms.
native_checks_for_root.why: pages/chat/index.nvue:87-102 releases its own archiveBusy on a 300 ms timer; ChatPanel keeps its separate lock until completion, so duplicate operations are guarded but parent button appearance may re-enable early.
